title: Théorie de Hodge: I, II, III

definitions.statement: Vector space V_Q with increasing weight filtration W_* and decreasing Hodge filtration F^* on V_C inducing pure Hodge structure of weight k on Gr_k^W(V).
Cohomology class which is Hodge under all complex embeddings and compatible with de Rham and l-adic comparison isomorphisms.

theorems.label: Deligne Mixed Hodge Theorem
theorems.statement: The cohomology of any complex algebraic variety (possibly singular or non-compact) canonically carries a mixed Hodge structure.

theorems.label: Strict Positivity & Degeneration
theorems.statement: The Hodge-de Rham spectral sequence degenerates at E_1 for smooth projective varieties over C.

theorems.label: Deligne's Theorem on Absolute Hodge Cycles
theorems.statement: Every Hodge cycle on an abelian variety of CM-type is an absolute Hodge cycle.

conjectures.label: Hodge Conjecture on Abelian Varieties
conjectures.statement: Hodge classes on abelian varieties are generated by divisor classes and algebraic correspondences.

open_gaps: Absolute Hodge property does not automatically deliver algebraic cycles without Grothendieck's standard conjectures on algebraic cycles.
computational_handles: Weight and Hodge filtration rank computations on nodal curves and singular surfaces.
Murnaghan-Nakayama or character decomposition of Mumford-Tate groups for abelian varieties.
Verification of absolute Hodge cycles on product abelian surfaces E x E.
